title: 4-leading category lockups
slide_intent: Use a consistent leading sign to make category names read as related destinations.
strategic_value: The repeated green 4 can let Channel 4 expand content labels while keeping the parent identity visible.
demonstration: A tall list pairs green 4 marks with white Drama, Comedy, Docs and Sport labels; one row contains an outlined placeholder.
practical_value: Compare a fixed symbol position with variable label lengths.

content_islands.name: Category column
content_islands.spec: Align the green marks vertically to the left of the large white names.

content_islands.name: Open slot
content_islands.spec: Keep the empty outlined label row among the examples to indicate extensibility.

reference_purposes.Application: The page applies a shared leading mark to several content categories.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram calls 4 leads the basis of the lockup framework.

ingredient.name: Leading 4 lockup
ingredient.role: Connect category labels to the parent brand.
ingredient.application: Place the 4 before the category name as demonstrated.
ingredient.scope: The 2023 source states the leading principle; this artwork supplies no numeric spacing specification.
